title: Medtrum Pump unreachable after 2 minutes
symptom: Medtrum pump disconnects from the phone and AAPS cannot reconnect after about 2 minutes; restarting the phone restores control for only about 2 minutes before the pump becomes unreachable again.
cause: The MyBMW app's Nearby devices permission interferes with the Medtrum pump's Bluetooth connection to AAPS on Android 15/16, causing the pump to become unreachable after about 2 minutes.
fix: Remove/disable the 'Nearby devices permission' for the MyBMW app and decline the request to grant it; this resolves the Medtrum pump connection loss.
evidence_quote: Hello, I have no problem using BMW app without "Nearby devices permission". After removing the permission app asked me if I want to grant these permission, I clicked no and it does not bother me anymore.
